zh.title: 当评分过程写入了行动记录
zh.summary: 针对固定版本原方法的六组内部替身实验显示，奖励评估可把参考动作追加到行动记录，终止步骤也可进入这一评分路径。记录变更可能影响下游来源归属，但本身不证明奖励错误；历史影响范围、修复效果与现行版本行为仍未验证。

en.title: A closer match is not always a better fit for the task
en.summary: Two-dimensional counterexamples using explicitly chosen formulas show that irrelevant added capability or relaxed requirements can lower similarity while satisfaction scores stay unchanged. Internal demonstrations also separate score stability, choice stability and feasibility; they neither reproduce the original study nor establish real-task benefits.
